-- How to distribute the data across the compute node
-- DISTRIBUTION Types 
-- 1. HASH KEY  --- We need to specifiy the column 
-- 2. ROUND_ROBIN
-- 2. REPLICATE


DROP TABLE  dbo.VS
CREATE TABLE dbo.VS
(
    STUDYID VARCHAR(200),
    DOMAIN VARCHAR(200),
    USUBJID VARCHAR(200),
    VSSEQ VARCHAR(200),
    VSTESTCD VARCHAR(200),
    VSTEST VARCHAR(200),
    VSORRES VARCHAR(200),
    VSORRESU VARCHAR(200),
    VISITNUM VARCHAR(200),
    VISIT VARCHAR(200),
    VSDTC VARCHAR(200),
    MODIFIED_TS VARCHAR(200)
)
WITH
( DISTRIBUTION = HASH (USUBJID));


SELECT * FROM VS;


COPY INTO [dbo].[vs] FROM 'https://stsyndemo01.blob.core.windows.net/synapse-files/clintrail_data_files/VS/VS.csv'
WITH (
   FIELDTERMINATOR=',',
   ROWTERMINATOR='0x0A'
) OPTION (LABEL = 'COPY: dbo.VS');


SELECT COUNT(*) FROM VS;



DBCC PDW_SHOWSPACEUSED('dbo.VS');


SELECT USUBJID, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM VS GROUP BY USUBJID;




-------------------------------------------------------------

CREATE TABLE LB (
        STUDYID VARCHAR(200),
        DOMAIN VARCHAR(200),
        USUBJID VARCHAR(200),
        LBSEQ VARCHAR(200),
        LBTESTCD VARCHAR(200),  
        LBTEST VARCHAR(200),
        LBCAT VARCHAR(200),
        LBORRES VARCHAR(200),
        LBORRESU VARCHAR(200),
        LBORNRLO VARCHAR(200),
        LBORNRHI VARCHAR(200),
        LBNRIND VARCHAR(200),
        VISITNUM VARCHAR(200),
        VISIT VARCHAR(200),
        LBDTC VARCHAR(200),
        MODIFIED_TS VARCHAR(200)
    )
    WITH (DISTRIBUTION  = ROUND_ROBIN)


COPY INTO [dbo].[LB] FROM 'https://stsyndemo01.blob.core.windows.net/synapse-files/clintrail_data_files/LB/LB.csv'
WITH (
   FIELDTERMINATOR=',',
   ROWTERMINATOR='0x0A'
) OPTION (LABEL = 'COPY: dbo.LB');



SELECT * FROM LB;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM LB;

DBCC PDW_SHOWSPACEUSED('dbo.LB');


CREATE TABLE TS
(
    STUDYID VARCHAR(200),
    DOMAIN VARCHAR(200),
    TSPARMCD VARCHAR(200),
    TSPARM VARCHAR(200),
    TSVAL VARCHAR(200),
    MODIFIED_TS VARCHAR(200)
) WITH (DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE )



COPY INTO [dbo].[TS] FROM 'https://stsyndemo01.blob.core.windows.net/synapse-files/clintrail_data_files/TS/TS.csv'
WITH (
   FIELDTERMINATOR=',',
   ROWTERMINATOR='0x0A'
) OPTION (LABEL = 'COPY: dbo.TS');


SELECT * FROM [dbo].[TS]


DBCC PDW_SHOWSPACEUSED('dbo.TS');
